name: 亚马逊吹箭兵
nameJa: アマゾネスの吹き矢兵
desc: 每次自己的准备阶段选择对方场上1只怪兽。选择的怪兽的攻击力直到回合结束时下降500。
faq:
When a monster selected for "Amazoness Blowpiper"'s effect is flipped face-down, the effect is reset.
After selecting a monster with "Amazoness Blowpiper"'s effect, if "Amazoness Blowpiper" is flipped face-down or removed from the field, its effect still applies until the end of the turn.
ruling:
“Amazoness Blowpiper” may only target a face-up card.Q: Can “Amazoness Blowpiper’s” effect be used more than once per turn?
A: As per the card text, it says you use the effect once during each of your Standby phases. That is the only time the effect is used. Curtis Schultz, “Amazoness Blowpiper” may only target a face-up card.
